run_pipeline_wan_animate: run the WanAnimatePipeline to generate character animation video from a reference image and pose video
run_pipeline_wan_animate_replace: run the WanAnimatePipeline in replace mode to substitute a character in a background video using pose and face videos
encode_prompt_t5: encode text prompts into T5 hidden state embeddings for the WanAnimate diffusion model
encode_reference_image: encode a reference character image into CLIP vision embeddings and VAE latents for the animation pipeline
prepare_pose_latents: encode a pose video into standardized VAE latents for conditioning the WanAnimate transformer
